entities.summary: Naomi Chazan is an Israeli academic, activist, and politician. As a legislator, Chazan championed the causes of human rights, women's rights, and consumer protection. Chazan is a past president of the New Israel Fund. Naomi Chazan was a writers & intellectuals from Jerusalem (b. 1946-11-18, Jerusalem). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
